adds.rationale: Cameco strengthens the nuclear buildup thesis structurally (Westinghouse acquisition, decade-high uranium contracting) right as SMR's single-project thesis broke, giving diversified nuclear-fuel-cycle exposure without one-reactor-vendor risk.

news_evidence.summary: Cameco and Brookfield received approval to acquire Westinghouse Electric, expected to close ~Nov 7, financed via a $600M term loan plus cash
Cameco signed a uranium supply agreement with CNNC and reported decade-high industry contracting volume alongside gross-profit improvement in Q3

removes.rationale: NuScale's flagship UAMPS/Idaho Carbon Free Power Project, the commercial proof point for the SMR thesis, was mutually terminated Nov 8 2023 — a fundamental thesis breach the stock has not recovered from.

news_evidence.summary: UAMPS and NuScale mutually agreed to terminate the Carbon Free Power Project at Idaho National Laboratory after insufficient subscription
SMR shares fell to an all-time low of $1.81 after the project termination and Q3 earnings

rationale_overall: One clean swap: SMR exits on a real dated thesis breach (its sole flagship commercial project was cancelled Nov 8), and CCJ enters to keep the nuclear wave represented but de-risked from single-reactor-vendor exposure via Cameco's Westinghouse acquisition and decade-high uranium contracting. Everything else held: MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA all had concrete Q4 AI catalysts (365 Copilot GA, Gemini 1.0), RKLB and IONQ hit milestones (SDA contract, bookings inflection), SYM's Walmart-driven backlog grew, ITA and FRO benefited from the Oct 7 shock and record tanker economics respectively, and WELL posted strong senior-housing NOI growth — none showing a breach or peak signal. Watchlist stays at cap 10 with nuclear-bucket diversity preserved (one nuclear name, a structurally stronger one).
